name: seatd
description: Minimal seat management daemon and library (libseat), mediating access to shared devices (GPU, input) without requiring compositor processes to run as root. Used by wlroots as a systemd-logind alternative, ideal for non-systemd distros.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
